observations.action: One insect facing upper right, with laterally fanned wings and luminous abdomen trailing down-right, in front of a separate rising flame.
observations.mass: Large overlapping wings, body, abdomen, and flame fill most of the image; the animal is much larger than in the owner reference.
observations.facets: Connected irregular polygons cover the head, thorax, abdomen, wings, and flame; no square pixel grid.
observations.anatomy: One small visible dark eye, no smiling face, short antennae, and little visible leg detail.
observations.interestPoint: Tall rising flame behind and above the left shoulder, balanced by the luminous abdomen.
observations.nightMotif: Very dark blue-green crescent, scattered small star marks, and multiple shallow cloud contours along outer areas.
observations.material: Warm bronze and gold body, champagne wings, cool teal and violet wing-edge planes, and an orange-gold flame.
caveats: Flame edges remain sharp and the rendering is somewhat crystalline.
The flame tip and upper-right wing are closer to the image edge than the requested calm border.
There are more cloud contours and star marks than the minimal motif proposal.
